text.arabic_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا

words.gloss_range: opening connector with resumptive force into a possession clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes after the punishment sequence in 48:6 and turns the reader toward the warrant for those consequences rather than adding another punishment item. Its attached position before the possessive phrase makes the transition continuous: the prior verdict is reconnected to the declaration that the forces belong to God. The compact sound of the opening keeps linkage, new-start force, and possession moving as one entry into the ayah.

topics.headline: resumptive warrant after prior verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector supplies the cosmic warrant for the previous punishment sequence, not another item in that sequence.
topics.reason: The rows consistently treat the opening connector as resumptive after 48:6 while local syntax begins a new possession declaration.

topics.headline: bound entry into possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the connector enter directly into the possessive declaration, so ownership is not delayed as a later explanation.
topics.reason: The surface joins the connector to the following possessive phrase, supporting a continuous entry into the clause.

words.gloss_range: possessive preposition marking divine ownership and fronted restriction
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the possessive preposition, so the forces are introduced as God-owned before they are even named. Because the phrase is fronted, its ownership relation scopes over the whole host construction: the armies of the heavens and the earth are processed under divine possession from the first phrase. This is stronger than a neutral report of association; it restricts the inventory to its owner before the inventory unfolds.

topics.headline: possessive ownership marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes the hosts possessed forces, not merely forces associated with God.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the preposition as possessive and governing the divine name.

topics.headline: fronted scope over inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership is fixed before the armies appear, so the whole cosmic inventory arrives already claimed.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is the fronted predicate before the delayed subject, giving it scope over the whole host phrase.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name as the fronted possessor of the host inventory
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name root field with deity, worship, and turning/refuge associations; local syntax selects the unique possessor role
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) names the possessor inside the fronted phrase, and its genitive case keeps the role precise: this first divine-name occurrence is not the subject of the later attribute clause but the owner under the possessive preposition. The proper name gives the ownership claim unique divine identity, while the recorded deity, worship, and turning/refuge root pressures remain supportive rather than replacing the local syntactic role. The same name returns later as nominative subject, so this first occurrence helps the ayah move from God as owner of the hosts to God as bearer of permanent attributes. Same-surah echoes extend the same ownership grammar from hosts here to dominion in 48:14.

topics.headline: case-marked possessor role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this occurrence of the divine name is grammatically the possessor, not the later subject of the attribute seal.
topics.reason: The name is governed by the possessive preposition in the fronted predicate; the later nominative occurrence carries a different role.

topics.headline: unique name with worship orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship and desperate-turning associations enrich the named possessor, while syntax still keeps the local claim about ownership of the hosts.
topics.reason: The derivational and semantic rows are meaningful pressure, but they cannot override the local proper-name and genitive-possessor function.

topics.headline: ownership refrain and domain pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fronted divine-name phrase belongs to a repeated ownership pattern that later broadens from forces to dominion (48:14).
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and echo rows connect this fronted possession phrase with divine-host passages and with the same ownership grammar in 48:14.

words.gloss_range: plural host forces as the delayed possessed subject specified by cosmic domains
words.root_gloss_range: organized-force root range; locally expanded from troops to all command-ready forces under divine ownership
words.prose: {{ar:جُنُودُ}} ({{tr:junūdu}}) is the delayed nominative subject, but it arrives only after ownership has been fixed, so semantically active forces are grammatically presented as possessed instruments. Its broken plural and organized-force field make the inventory multiple and deployable, not a single army or inert territory. As a construct head, it gathers both the heavens and the earth into one host domain, so celestial and terrestrial forces form one divine inventory. The reprise from 48:4 frames both calming and punishment under the same sovereignty claim, while the unspecified inventory also resonates with the limit of host-knowledge in 74:31.

topics.headline: delayed possessed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the armies never appear as autonomous actors; they are disclosed only after their owner is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the fronted predicate and delayed subject, and the rows stress that the hosts are the possessed entity.

topics.headline: plural deployable forces
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that military language expands into all command-ready forces, while the clause keeps those forces subordinate to divine ownership.
topics.reason: The root field supports troops, helpers, and organized bodies; local grammar narrows this to possessed cosmic forces rather than independent military agents.

topics.headline: host refrain and unitemized inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated host formula brackets reward and punishment (48:4; 48:7), while the forces remain unitemized as an inventory known fully only to God (74:31).
topics.reason: Inter-ayah rows explicitly cite the same host phrase in 48:4 and the unknown-host limit in 74:31, with later formula echoes also present.

words.gloss_range: definite plural upper domain specifying where the hosts extend
words.root_gloss_range: elevation, upper realm, and canopy range; local phrase selects the plural elevated domain within a heavens-earth merism
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) is genitive because it specifies the domain of the hosts, not because it competes with God as possessor. Its definite plural keeps the upper realm layered and total, matching the plurality of the host inventory. The elevated/canopy image gives the upper half of the merism concrete vertical force, and the following earth term completes the high-low totality. The same heavens-earth pair recurs with hosts in 48:4 and 48:7 and with dominion in 48:14, so the domain language carries a same-surah progression from forces to rule.

topics.headline: genitive plural upper domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens specify the hosts domain as a definite layered upper realm while God remains the owner.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the word as the genitive complement of the construct host noun, and the form rows identify definite plural scope.

topics.headline: upper pole of vertical totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an elevated, enclosing upper pole that pairs with earth to make divine ownership vertically total.
topics.reason: The elevation and canopy senses are locally selected only as upper-domain pressure inside the merism, not as a separate cosmological claim.

topics.headline: domain refrain from forces to dominion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same heavens-earth domain supports the host claim in 48:4 and 48:7 before broadening to dominion in 48:14.
topics.reason: The echo rows explicitly link the merism with hosts in 48:4 and 48:7 and dominion in 48:14.

words.gloss_range: local coordinator joining earth to heavens inside the host construct
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) here does not open a new clause; it coordinates the earth with the heavens inside the same construct phrase. That local scope matters because the high and low domains remain one host inventory under one owner. The attached sound and recitation flow prevent the merism from splitting into separate claims.

topics.headline: local domain coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is added inside the same host phrase, not introduced as a separate statement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the earth term as conjoined with the heavens under the same construct head.

topics.headline: inclusive high-low link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector joins vertical opposites inclusively, turning contrast into total scope.
topics.reason: The particle joins the second merism term directly and supports one paired unit in sound and syntax.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as the lower domain completing the host merism
words.root_gloss_range: ground, land, breadth, and terrestrial-force range; locally the total lower pole paired with the plural heavens
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is the second genitive domain under the same host noun, so it is not an afterthought or a new locality. Its definite singular gathers the whole terrestrial pole as one domain, balancing the plural heavens with the known earth. The root field gives this lower pole concrete breadth and possible earth-force pressure, while the merism makes the point larger: no territory, whether above or below, lies outside the divine host inventory. Its final position closes the first beat before the attribute seal explains the owner as mighty and wise.

topics.headline: second governed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth shares the same governed role as the heavens, completing one construct phrase rather than beginning another claim.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark earth as genitive and conjoined with the heavens as the second complement of the host noun.

topics.headline: terrestrial pole and beat landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole lower domain gathered as earth, closing the cosmic span before the ayah pivots to the attribute seal.
topics.reason: The earth senses are locally selected as the lower pole of the merism and the first-clause landing, not a particular land parcel.

topics.headline: earth in repeated totality formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common earth term becomes marked when folded into the divine-host formula, outscaling earthly armies (28:39) and recurring with the same total domain in 48:4 and 48:14.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows connect earth with heavens as a dominant formula and specialize it through the host construction and same-surah echoes.

words.gloss_range: connector opening the explanatory attribute clause after the ownership beat
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the copular seal pivots from the possession clause into the attribute seal. It links the two beats so the attributes are heard as the rationale for the host declaration, not as a detached maxim. The bound form and cadence restart the ayah after the long merism, shifting from the inventory of forces to the permanent qualities of their owner.

topics.headline: explanatory seal connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the attribute pair explains the ownership claim rather than floating as an unrelated divine description.
topics.reason: The connector introduces the coordinated copular clause after the nominal possession clause.

topics.headline: register and cadence pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from enacted verdicts and possessed forces into timeless divine attributes.
topics.reason: The boundary and structure rows mark a shift from the preceding event chain and possession beat into an ontological attribute clause.

words.gloss_range: copular perfect introducing permanent divine attributes
words.root_gloss_range: being/existence root range; locally a copular, timeless divine predication rather than an event verb
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) is singular and copular, so the attribute seal predicates the qualities of God, not of the plural hosts. Although formally perfect, the divine-subject construction gives the clause timeless force: might and wisdom are not newly acquired after the host declaration. The verb also changes the architecture of the ayah from a nominal ownership claim to a permanent attribute ground, and the exact closing formula returns in 48:19.

topics.headline: copular frame and singular form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb assigns the two attributes to God rather than making the hosts act or receive action.
topics.reason: The verb has no object and governs a subject plus accusative predicates; singular agreement points to the divine subject.

topics.headline: timeless divine predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the perfect form functions as enduring divine predication, not a past-only report.
topics.reason: QAC labels the construction as eternality, and semantic rows select permanent being with God as subject.

topics.headline: architecture and formula seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shift from cosmic inventory to enduring attribute seal, with the same formula returning in 48:19.
topics.reason: Structure rows mark the nominal-to-copular pivot, and echo rows identify the same closing formula in 48:19 and related same-surah formulas.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as explicit subject of the attribute seal
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name root field with deity, worship, and turning/refuge associations; local syntax selects the named subject of the two predicates
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) repeats the same divine name but changes case and role: the earlier occurrence was genitive possessor, while this one is nominative subject of the copular seal. The explicit name, rather than a pronoun, recenters the attribute pair on the very owner just named, so invincible might and wisdom do not drift toward the hosts or remain abstract. The worship and refuge orientation attached to the name survives as semantic pressure, but local grammar makes the main payoff the identity of the attribute bearer.

topics.headline: nominative attribute bearer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the nominative divine name is the subject bearing both attributes, while the following words are predicates.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the subject of the copular verb, distinct from the accusative predicates.

topics.headline: identity and worship orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named subject carries worship and refuge orientation into the seal, while local grammar keeps subjecthood primary.
topics.reason: The semantic rows enrich the name, but syntax narrows their function to the identity of the attribute bearer.

topics.headline: formula hub across clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated divine name is the hub connecting owned hosts with the recurrent mighty-wise attribute formula.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and echo rows connect the divine name with the host field, the copular formula, and same-surah divine-name anchoring.

words.gloss_range: first accusative predicate naming invincible, inaccessible might paired with wisdom
words.root_gloss_range: might, strength, inaccessibility, rarity, and preciousness range; locally selects invincible divine power under wise restraint
words.prose: {{ar:عَزِيزًا}} ({{tr:ʿazīzan}}) is the first accusative predicate of the copular clause, so invincible might is predicated of God as the owner of the hosts. Its root field gives more than generic strength: hardness, resistance, inaccessibility, and preciousness make the host-owner impossible to overpower or compel. The form is an indefinite intensive quality, not a detached title, and it is immediately paired with the following wisdom predicate, so the force is governed rather than arrogant or brute. Same-surah recurrence traces the quality from the mighty victory of 48:3 back to its divine source here and forward to the formula in 48:19.

topics.headline: predicate form and cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that might is a predicated, durable quality of God, heard as part of a matched closing pair.
topics.reason: The rows identify the word as an accusative indefinite predicate with stable adjective morphology and paired cadence.

topics.headline: invincible force under wisdom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine might is unapproachable and unconquerable, yet paired with wise restraint rather than destructive pride.
topics.reason: The semantic rows support invincibility, inaccessibility, and preciousness; local pairing selects invincible authority balanced by wisdom.

topics.headline: victory quality traced to source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quality attached to victory in 48:3 is redirected to God in 48:7 and then recurs in 48:19, identifying the source of victorious force.
topics.reason: The echo rows explicitly connect 48:3, 48:4, 48:7, and 48:19 in the shift from knowledge to power and from victory to divine attribute.

words.gloss_range: second accusative predicate closing the ayah with wise governance of power
words.root_gloss_range: wisdom, judgment, restraint, firm construction, and mastery range; locally the durable governance that directs divine force
words.prose: {{ar:حَكِيمًا}} ({{tr:ḥakīman}}) is the second accusative predicate, equal in grammatical force to the preceding might predicate, and it closes the ayah. Its root family links wisdom with judgment, firm construction, mastery, and the bridle image, so the final word does not merely praise intelligence; it names governed precision over the hosts. The adjective pattern makes that wisdom a durable attribute, while the rhyme and final position bind it to might as the last control on cosmic force. Echoes with 48:4, 9:40, and 48:19 make this closing wisdom a repeated seal for divine deployment and provision.

topics.headline: second predicate form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wisdom is directly predicated of God as the equal counterpart to might, not an adverbial aside.
topics.reason: Attachment and QAC evidence identify the word as the second accusative predicate with matched adjective form.

topics.headline: wise governance and restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wisdom functions as governing restraint over force, like reins directing power rather than letting it become arbitrary.
topics.reason: The semantic rows support judgment, restraint, mastery, and bridle imagery; local context selects governed deployment of the host inventory.

topics.headline: final closure and echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wisdom is the ayahs final word and a repeated closing constant across 48:4, 48:7, 9:40, and 48:19.
topics.reason: Structure and echo rows identify final position, same-surah recurrence, and the host-and-attribute pattern in 9:40.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive construction joins God's hosts to the coordinated heavens and earth, then predicates might and wisdom of the same owner.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mutually supporting plurality spans the upper covering realm and its lower counterpart while answering to one center. Might supplies effective superiority, but wisdom makes this a governed deployment rather than an inventory of uncontrolled violence.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one appears as both possessor and predicated agent, giving the whole muster a single center of answerability.
A gathered body whose members support one another supplies coordinated plurality rather than isolated instruments.
What rises and covers supplies the upper domain of the comprehensive muster.
The lower realm opposite the sky closes the vertical span so that no domain of agency falls outside the claim.
Prevailing force makes the ownership operational rather than merely titular.
Knowledge that reaches the right judgment governs how prevailing force is used.

changed_reading.before: God has many armies located in the sky and on earth.
changed_reading.after: Every mutually supporting agency across upper and lower creation answers to one command, whose effective force is inseparable from right judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent predicates عزيزًا حكيمًا qualify the owner of the hosts, while the host root itself emphasizes mutual reinforcement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Strength can reinforce one element with another, while wisdom can prevent, return, and bridle. The pairing therefore permits a force system whose ability to stop or redirect motion is part of its strength, not a limit imposed from outside.

activation_trace.role: Mutually supporting members provide the coordinated body that can reinforce or check its own motion.
Reinforcing one by another defines might as relational strengthening within the host.
Prevention and return for the sake of repair make checking harmful motion a positive function of wisdom.
The bridle image gives the force system a concrete steering and stopping mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Might and wisdom are two generic praises appended to a military claim.
changed_reading.after: The hosts are strong partly because their motion can be reinforced, steered, stopped, and returned toward repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first contextual cue makes opening both the release of closure and a judicial separation. Read back into 48:7, the hosts are not only bodies that overpower resistance; they are capacities by which a closed condition becomes access under judgment.

activation_trace.role: The mutually supporting host supplies the plurality of means available for transformation.
Judgment in the focus anchors the contextual opening as adjudicated rather than merely breached.
The release of what was shut contributes the transition from blocked condition to widened access.
Judicially separating a closure supplies the governing operation that aligns opening with حكيم.

structural_cues: 48:1 opens the pericope with a doubled ف ت ح construction before 48:7 names the comprehensive hosts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, judicial separation, a coordinated host, and judgment; I infer that the hosts can mediate a passage from closure to access. Military victory remains a live narrower alternative.

changed_reading.before: The hosts guarantee superior force against an opponent.
changed_reading.after: The hosts include governed means that unseal a blocked situation and convert closure into a judged opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 48:4 tranquility is delivered into hearts and produces growth in faith immediately before the same host formula. This makes an inward cessation of destabilizing motion a concrete candidate member or operation of the hosts, so the focus repetition can name invisible regulation as power.

activation_trace.role: A host can comprise any coordinated class of supporters, leaving room for non-personal inward agencies.
Delivery downward supplies the directional movement by which the inward force arrives.
The loss of agitated motion is the host's immediate nonviolent effect.
The heart supplies the interior theater in which this force operates.
Growth shows that stilling agitation is productive reinforcement rather than mere passivity.

structural_cues: 48:4 places tranquility, hearts, and increased faith directly before a verbatim recurrence of ولله جنود السماوات والأرض, changing only the first final predicate from عليم to the focus's عزيز.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered stillness, an interior site, resulting growth, and the repeated host clause; I infer that tranquility exemplifies how a host can act. The alternative is that the repeated clause only reassures without classifying tranquility.

changed_reading.before: The heavenly and earthly hosts are external reserves of coercive power.
changed_reading.after: A decisive host may be the inward force that stills destabilization in hearts and thereby increases their capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel moves from a sent witness to pledged hands arranged under a higher hand and bound by a preserved covenant. This activates a social reading of the hosts as a distributed command network whose cohesion is testimony and pledged fidelity, not merely co-location.

activation_trace.role: Mutual support anchors the focus host as a coordinated social body.
Presence with witnessing supplies the network's public evidentiary function.
A pledge of obedience converts separate persons into an answerable collective.
The hand as power makes embodied human agency the transmitted working edge of the network.
Higher rank orders the pledged hands vertically without erasing their plurality.
A preserved covenant supplies durable cohesion and accountability through time.

structural_cues: 48:8-10 follows the focus immediately, moving from divine hosts to a witness and then to multiple pledged hands under one higher hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witnessing, pledged obedience, layered hands, and covenant; I infer a command topology that realizes mutual support. The hand language can remain relational metaphor rather than a full definition of جنود.

changed_reading.before: A host is an already constituted mass available to its owner.
changed_reading.after: A host can be constituted through witnessed allegiance: many embodied powers become one durable command network by covenant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call to a hard fight is followed by explicit relief for blindness, lameness, and illness while obedience remains morally salient. This prevents the total ownership claim in 48:7 from becoming indiscriminate conscription: wise command differentiates obligation by embodied capacity.

activation_trace.role: Prevention for repair anchors the focus's wisdom as a check on harmful overextension.
Obedient yielding supplies the general response requested of those called.
Loss of sight marks a concrete capacity boundary that wise muster recognizes.
Impaired gait adds a distinct mobility boundary rather than a generalized excuse.
Diminished movement from illness supplies the third embodied limit on participation.

structural_cues: 48:16's combat summons is immediately qualified by three parallel no-blame clauses in 48:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a summons, obedience, and differentiated bodily exemptions; I infer that حكيم governs who may be mobilized and at what cost. The exemptions directly regulate human participants, while the wider cosmic hosts remain broader.

changed_reading.before: Comprehensive ownership of hosts suggests maximal mobilization of every available body.
changed_reading.after: Wise ownership includes capacity-sensitive non-mobilization; a governed host is not built by erasing bodily limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from inward stillness to a near opening, then to held-back hands and a further outcome beyond present human capacity but already encompassed. The hosts therefore include timed reserves and preventative operations: force can be present as secured possibility before it becomes humanly executable.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time anchor the focus attributes as a pattern manifested across stages.
Stilled motion is the first deployed effect in the temporal sequence.
An opening that begins what follows makes the present result an installment rather than the whole deployment.
Temporal nearness locates one outcome on an ordered horizon.
Active prevention makes a withheld human hand one of the sequence's achieved effects.
Capacity to carry an act distinguishes present human inability from the owner's effective power.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and securing holds the unrealized outcome as a protected reserve.

structural_cues: 48:19 repeats the focus's exact وكان الله عزيزًا حكيمًا pair inside a chain of near, withheld, not-yet-capable, and encompassed outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged sequence and distinguishes human capacity from divine encompassing; I infer that some hosts operate as timed prevention or reserved possibility. The alternative is that these are only successive benefits, not a taxonomy of hosts.

changed_reading.before: The hosts are forces available for immediate release whenever power is asserted.
changed_reading.after: The hosts include a temporally governed reserve: calm now, an opening near, hostile hands held, and further capacity secured before human access.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the interior of Mecca, victory has already been granted, yet both hostile hands and the believers' hands are prevented. This reverses a simple conquest reading: after superiority exists, its wise manifestation is reciprocal non-striking.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing power anchors the capacity that makes restraint chosen rather than forced.
The bridle image supplies a concrete focus mechanism for stopping force after control is obtained.
Active withholding is the central event, not an absence of action.
Hands as power identify the opposed capacities that are simultaneously checked.
The inside of a place locates restraint at the conflict's vulnerable center rather than at a remote margin.
Victory by prevailing confirms that non-use follows achieved superiority.

structural_cues: 48:24 grammatically makes mutual withholding occur after God has granted victory over the opposing side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies achieved victory plus prevention of both sets of hands; I infer that restraint itself can be a deployed host of the mighty and wise. A narrower tactical ceasefire reading remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Divine might is demonstrated when its hosts overpower and strike the opposing side.
changed_reading.after: Divine might can be demonstrated by possessing victory and then deploying the stronger act of withholding both sides' power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The feared operation would trample unknown believers and stain the actors with unintended harm; punitive force becomes permissible only in the counterfactual of separation. Wisdom thus functions as target discrimination that delays force until unlike populations can be distinguished.

activation_trace.role: Prevention for repair anchors the decision not to unleash a harmful operation.
Severe pressure underfoot supplies the concrete collateral mechanism being prevented.
A stain by evil names the unintended moral and social consequence of imprecise force.
Separation and discrimination provide the missing condition under which force could reach its intended target.

structural_cues: 48:25 makes non-separation the condition blocking punishment and separation the counterfactual condition under which it could proceed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intermingling, trampling risk, harmful stain, and a separation counterfactual; I infer a targeting rule internal to حكيم. The immediate case is specific, but it visibly changes how the focus pair constrains force.

changed_reading.before: Comprehensive hosts imply that sufficient power can always reach an enemy directly.
changed_reading.after: Sufficient power refuses indiscriminate reach: the wise host waits for discriminable targets rather than converting hidden innocents into collateral damage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heated pride in one set of hearts is answered by delivered stillness and a binding word of protection in another. The focus hosts can therefore be read as competing affective and verbal regimes, with wise might cooling escalation and fixing a protective norm in place.

activation_trace.role: Coordinated supporting classes anchor the extension of host language to organized inward forces.
Pride and anger supply the heated mobilization that threatens to govern conduct.
Delivery into the scene supplies the countermovement by which regulation arrives.
Cessation of motion counters affective heat without mirroring its violence.
Binding by judgment fixes the counterforce into a durable verbal commitment.
Protection from harm states the function of the bound word and the regulated affect.

structural_cues: 48:26 sets two heart-states in antiphony: placed heat and pride versus descended stillness joined to an imposed protective word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed affects, delivery, stilling, binding, and protection; I infer that these can function as rival hosts within conduct. They may instead be effects of unnamed hosts, so the classification remains functional rather than lexical.

changed_reading.before: The hosts act on the outer battlefield while human emotion merely reacts.
changed_reading.after: The decisive battlefield can be affective: heated pride mobilizes one regime, while descended stillness and protective speech form its stronger counter-host.

context_deltas.mechanism: A true vision is not realized in the expected immediate form; a nearer opening is placed before its fulfillment, followed by eventual manifestation and sufficient witness. This reads the focus's might and wisdom as power over sequence and legibility, not pressure for instant maximal display.

activation_trace.role: Presence and occurrence in time anchor the divine attributes across delayed and intermediate realizations.
A dream vision supplies a promised image whose truth need not dictate immediate timing.
Nearness short of the final goal creates an intermediate station rather than a failed fulfillment.
An opening that begins what follows makes the intermediate event generative.
Temporal nearness marks the inserted opening as the next stage, not the endpoint.
Emergence into visibility supplies the eventual public phase of what was first promised as vision.
Standing over an affair until sufficiency is reached replaces anxiety for immediate completion with adequate governance.
Knowledge-bearing testimony makes the staged result legible and accountable.

structural_cues: 48:27 distinguishes promised entry from an intervening near opening; 48:28 then moves to manifestation and sufficient witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a true vision, an intermediate opening, later manifestation, and sufficiency of witness; I infer that the hosts can govern timing and disclosure. The manifestation may unfold through proclamation and social change rather than warfare alone.

changed_reading.before: Might should make the promised outcome appear immediately and in its most direct form.
changed_reading.after: Wise might can route fulfillment through an intermediate opening and delayed manifestation, preserving the promise while changing its sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing plant grows by sending out shoots, having them support the source, thickening, and standing on load-bearing stalks. This is a material enactment of the focus host as a mutually supporting collective: strength emerges recursively from weak extensions rather than arriving only as a preassembled army.

activation_trace.role: A gathered class that mutually supports its members supplies the direct focus anchor for organic collectivity.
Soft fertile earth supplies the medium in which a host can be generated rather than merely stationed.
Cultivation and growth provide the overall generative process.
Emergence from inside to outside turns latent capacity into a new supporting member.
Shoots arising around the source give the collective its branching multiplicity.
Plants strengthening one another supplies the reciprocal support mechanism closest to جند.
Thickening after thinness shows strength as an acquired collective state.
Straightness and completion mark the formation's achieved integrity.
The load-bearing stalk gives the matured collective stable support.

structural_cues: 48:29 closes the pericope with a continuous emergence-support-thickening-standing sequence after 48:7's compact ownership claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual support in جند and a plant whose extensions strengthen the source; I infer that the plant is a model of how an earthly host forms. It may describe one human collective rather than every cosmic host, so the broader extension remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: A host is assembled from already strong units and then deployed from above.
changed_reading.after: An earthly host can grow from below: weak shoots emerge, reinforce their source, thicken together, and become a stable load-bearing collective.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows the packet's split mapping from focus س م و to و س م and then meets context س و م at the same mapped root. It remains anchored in the focus's heavens and hosts and is reinforced by the face-mark and lasting-trace sequence in 48:29; downstream prose should present it as a semiotic activation, not replace السماوات with an etymological claim about marks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word السماوات has a packet-supplied و س م target, while جنود permits a coordinated class of non-identical agents.

activation_trace.role: A coordinated class allows marks and signs to be considered collectively by their shared function.
A visible impress that identifies something activates the heavens as a field bearing legible signatures.
A sign from which an observer reads a condition gives those signatures an evidentiary function.
The visible condition read in faces gives an embodied context instance of the same sign function.
A remaining trace that indicates what occurred explains how an invisible history becomes publicly legible.

changed_reading.before: The heavenly hosts are hidden beings or forces that intervene in events.
changed_reading.after: One exploratory class of heavenly host is semiotic: coordinated marks and durable traces that make an otherwise hidden condition readable on earth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is odd because it links the packet's rocky-ground branch for جند, cohesive-ground branch for عزيز, and bridle branch for حكيم. Every link is focus-anchored and together they form a coherent resistance-and-control mechanism; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy rather than claim that جنود literally means terrain here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes جنود, الأرض, عزيز, and حكيم, whose inventories jointly contain rough ground, lower terrain, cohesion, and a bridle.

activation_trace.role: Thick stony ground contributes a resistant material surface rather than a personal combatant.
The lower ground supplies the physical field on which resistance can bear load.
Cohesive hard earth contributes traction and refusal to yield as a material form of might.
A bridle converts raw traction into controlled stopping and directional force.

changed_reading.before: The earth is merely one location containing an army.
changed_reading.after: The earth itself can image a host as distributed resistance: hard, load-bearing traction whose strength becomes useful through braking and steering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it uses the packet's س م م target under focus س م و, moving from the vast heavens to narrow ingress and inward repair. It remains valid as an exploratory mechanism because the anchor is packet-supplied and 48:4 supplies descent into a heart immediately beside the repeated host clause; downstream prose should mark it as a scale-reversal analogy, not a lexical gloss of السماوات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus س م و to a target containing narrow apertures, inward speciality, and repair entering between divergent parties.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture supplies a micro-scale entry path that reverses the expectation of only vast, spectacular force.
An inwardly lodged speciality supplies the hidden interior presence reached through that path.
Repair entering between divergent parties gives the subtle ingress a reconciliatory function.
Delivered descent supplies the context arrow from an upper source toward an interior site.
The heart supplies the receiving interior in which subtle repair can take effect.

changed_reading.before: Heavenly hosts act at the largest scale through overwhelming public intervention.
changed_reading.after: A live scale-reversal reading sees a heavenly host in subtle ingress: force enters through a narrow path, reaches the interior, and repairs division from within.

strongest_changes: The exact 48:4 recurrence activates descended tranquility in hearts as a nonviolent inward host whose stillness produces growth.
48:24 makes mutual withholding after achieved victory a positive manifestation of عزيز حكيم rather than a failure to deploy force.
48:25 turns wisdom into target discrimination: force is delayed while intended and protected populations remain intermingled.
48:18-21 expands ownership into timed containment, including near openings, held hands, and outcomes secured beyond present human capacity.
48:29 recasts an earthly host as an organic collective generated through shoots that mutually reinforce, thicken, and stand.
summary.what_was_special: The focus formula did not settle into one military reading. Its branch structure remained live across inward affect, social covenant, legal exemption, temporal reserve, reciprocal restraint, discriminating force, organic growth, visible traces, and material control; might and wisdom repeatedly coexisted as power plus governance rather than power followed by apology.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated host clause beside tranquility strongly activates a host-function reading, but the syntax can still be read as reassurance about an effect produced by unnamed hosts.
The split-root semiotic and microchannel readings are packet-licensed and coherent but should remain explicitly exploratory rather than become lexical substitutions.
The plant mechanism may model one earthly human host without defining the full range of heavenly and earthly hosts.
Covenantal, affective, and temporal mechanisms may describe modes through which hosts operate rather than separate entities counted among them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Forces whose operation includes restraint.** `جنود` anchors ج ن د B001; `عزيزًا` anchors ع ز ز B001/B002 (might and prevailing); `حكيمًا` anchors ح ك م B001 and B006, restraint and the bridle-piece that restrains. The later withholding of hands in 48:20 and 48:24 supplies the concrete structural cue. I infer that some forces prevail by checking motion. The armies are not limited to agents of attack; controlled non-action belongs to their operation.
2. **A vertically complete field.** `السماوات` activates س م و B004 (overhead sky/cover), while `الأرض` activates ء ر ض B001 (lower ground opposite the sky). Their opposition encloses every level, later narrowed to `بطن مكة` (48:24), an interior location within that field. I infer that ownership of the extremes entails governance of the intervening positions. The ayah reads spatially as total coverage, not only a large inventory.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:24 makes the restraining branch of ح ك م concrete: hands are withheld inside Mecca after prevalence. The local interior also shows how the heavens-and-earth totality governs precise positions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A force spanning the whole vertical field.** Fixed `جُنُود` anchors ج ن د `B001`, "a gathered force of helpers"; fixed heaven and earth activate س م و `B004` (overhead sky and cover) and ء ر ض `B001` (lower ground opposite the sky). Ayah 48:10 will show only visible human hands, whereas 48:11 denies that those humans control harm or benefit. The packet supplies a top-to-bottom force and limited hands; I infer **full-field agency -> visible participants are instruments, not the boundary of causation**. The repeated force formula therefore corrects a narrowly military reading of `جنود`.

2. **Power with an internal brake.** Fixed `عَزِيزًا` anchors ع ز ز `B004`, reinforcing and strengthening, while `حَكِيمًا` anchors ح ك م `B001`, "restraining and turning back to set right." The adverse turn of 48:6, the binding pledge of 48:10, and the failed expected return in 48:12 all make direction and reversal salient. Those turns are supplied; I infer **strength + corrective restraint -> controlled redirection**. The adjective pair reads as a coupled control system rather than unqualified force followed by an ornamental attribute.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 48:10-11 corrected a visible-army reading by placing limited human hands beneath agency they cannot control. Ayah 48:12's failed-return expectation then made ح ك م `B001`, corrective turning-back, more diagnostic in the fixed `عزيزا حكيما` pair.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir amaç, tür veya karşılıklı destek ilişkisi çevresinde bir araya gelmiş topluluk; özellikle orduyu, yardımcıları ve destekçileri anlatır. Belirli söz kuruluşlarında toplanıp düzenlenmiş bir topluluğa veya uyumlarına göre birleşen ya da ayrışan can kümelerine uygulanır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, ortak bir bağ çevresinde toplanmış ve üyeleri birbirine destek olabilen bir topluluktur.

Aynı türden varlıkların ayrı bir sınıf halinde oluşturduğu topluluk da bu adla anılabilir.
Belirli kuruluşlarda söz, toplanıp düzenlenmiş bir topluluğu veya uyumlarına göre birleşen ve ayrışan can kümelerini niteler.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal topluluk ve kişi adlarıyla bunlara veya bir yere bağlılığı bildiren sıfatı kapsar; ordu, yardımcı, genel topluluk, sert arazi, taş ve yer adı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam, topluluk ve kişi adı olan bağımsız sözlük birimleriyle bir topluluğa ya da yere bağlılığı bildiren biçimi birlikte taşır. Adlandırma kullanımları ile aidiyet sıfatı ayrı facetlerde tutulur ve bunlardan genel bir çıplak anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğu veya kişiyi adlandıran sabit kullanımlar ile bir topluluğa ya da yere bağlılığı bildiren sıfat. Kapsam, belirli bir topluluk adını, kişilere verilmiş üç adı ve aidiyet biçimini içerir.

facets.statement: Dalın ortak işlevi, genel bir nesne veya eylemi anlatmak yerine adlandırma ve ada bağlılık bildirmedir.
Bir kullanım, belirli bir ülkedeki topluluğun sabit adıdır.
Üç ayrı sözlük birimi, kişilere verilen adlar olarak tanıklanmıştır.
Bir biçim, adı taşıyan topluluğa veya yere bağlılığı ve oradan olmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı bir topluluk adını, kişilere verilen üç ayrı adı ve bir topluluğa ya da yere bağlılığı bildiren biçimi bir araya getirir. Ad verme ile aidiyet bildirme, aynı dal içinde ayrı işlevlerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi dalın çekirdeğini hem somut yükselme hem de kişinin değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesi olarak açıkça kurar. Bakışın yukarı yönelmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yükselmeyi kapsar; gök, ad, av ve yarışma dallarının kalıplaşmış anlamlarını kendi içine almaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yükselme çekirdeği ile bakış, toplumsal konum ve gururlu duruşa bağlı özel kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak yukarı çıkması veya bir kişinin toplumsal değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesidir. Bakışın yukarı kaldırılması bu hareketin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkar veya yüksek duruma gelir.
Bir kişinin değeri, saygınlığı ya da toplumdaki yeri yükselir.
Bakış bir şeye doğru yukarı kaldırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükselmeyi dalın ortak çekirdeği sayar; bunu fiziksel yükselişe, bakışın kaldırılmasına ve değerli kişinin toplumdaki yerinin yükselmesine uygular.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, görünür bir yüksek gövde ya da çizgi gerektirir; görünmeden gerçekleşen genel yükselme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzaktan belirme çekirdeği, belirli görünme kalıpları ve ayın ufuk üstündeki görünüşüyle birlikte fakat ayrı kapsamlarla verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi üstte bulunup örten şey çekirdeğini gök ve tavanla verir; bulut, yağmur, bitki, atın sırtı ve her şeyin üst yanı kullanımlarını da açıkça ekler. Dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı aktarmaları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üstte olma ve örtme çekirdeği önde tutulur; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımları genel yükselme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gök, tavan ve üst yan anlamlarını yüksekte bulunup örtme çekirdeğinde birleştirir; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımlarını buna bağlı uzantılar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: üstteki gök veya örtü ve buna bağlı üstten gelen ya da üstte bulunan şeyler
concept_gloss.applicability: Gök ve tavan çekirdeğinin yanı sıra bulut, yağmur, bitki ve bir şeyin üst yanı için belirtilen bağlı kullanımları kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi çekirdeği bir topluluğun ıssız arazilere av için çıkması olarak verir; avcı adı, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği çorap da aynı av alanına bağlıdır. Dal çerçevesi bu bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel gitmeyi değil, av amacıyla açık ve ıssız araziye çıkmayı ve yalnız buna bağlı kişi, arama ve araç kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun avlanmak için kır ve çöl gibi ıssız arazilere çıkmasıdır. Avcılar, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği koruyucu çorap bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk avlanmak amacıyla kır veya çöl gibi ıssız araziye çıkar.
Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve karşı koyma anlamlarını birleştirir; bir kişiyle kimsenin yarışamaması ifadesini onun üstünlüğünün sonucu olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü soyut belirtiyi değil; yakma, kulak kesme veya çentikleme gibi yollarla bırakılan tanıtıcı fiziksel izi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ortak fiziksel işaretleme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; zırhın alt bölümündeki süslemeyi anlatan özel tamlama yalnızca kendi sözlüksel karşılığında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.
İşaret, kızgın araçla yakılarak, kulağın bir bölümü kesilerek veya çentik açılarak bırakılabilir.
Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.
